title: Anytime-Valid Subgraph Counting: code, raw results and artifact generator (WSDM 2027)
description: Code, tests, exact ground truth and raw per-run results for the WSDM 2027 paper Anytime-Valid Subgraph Counting: Confidence Sequences and Adaptive Stopping for Sampling-Based Estimation (Krish Sharma and Jatin Bedi). The script make_paper_artifacts.py regenerates every number, table and figure in the paper from the raw results in results_cr/.
